decision_summary: Approve v10.0 as an external runtime productization decision, not production execution authorization.
rationale: v10.0 decides whether the v9.x external runtime evidence chain is coherent enough to advance as a product-grade capability surface while keeping third-party validation and live execution authorization out of scope.
recommendation: Proceed only if release-state, organization, archmap, targeted tests, npm test, smoke, clean checkout, main CI, and tag CI remain green.
target_audience: AOF operator evaluating architecture and lifecycle traceability
expected_user_reaction: Operator can understand that production go/no-go views may explain AOF artifact relationships but do not replace AOF evidence.
